scripts.build: bun run theme:build && bun run --cwd frontend build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd frontend typecheck && bun run --cwd frontend typecheck:gateway && tsc -p services/artifact-publisher/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:unit: bun test frontend/src services/web-gateway services/ovis services/artifact-publisher packages/theme
scripts.test:ovis-chat: cd integrations/ovis/app && HERDR_TEST_MODE=unit bun test server/medo.test.ts server/codex.test.ts server/herdr-core/snapshot.test.ts src/lib/sentWaiting.test.ts src/components/ChatView.sentWaiting.test.tsx && bun test server/prompt.test.ts -t 'managed collapsed'
scripts.test:browser: bun tests/v2-browser.ts && bun tests/owner-auth-browser.ts && bun tests/assistant-browser.ts
scripts.build:ovis: cd integrations/ovis/app && VITE_MEDO_PROJECTS=1 bun run build
scripts.test:ovis-browser: bun tests/ovis-browser.ts && cd integrations/ovis/app && bun scripts/medo-sidebar-browser-qa.ts
